scripts.build: npm run generate:changelog-json && tsc --noEmit && wxt build --mode store
scripts.build:firefox: npm run generate:changelog-json && tsc --noEmit && wxt build -b firefox --mode store
scripts.build:preview: npm run generate:changelog-json && tsc --noEmit && wxt build --mode preview
scripts.build:preview:firefox: npm run generate:changelog-json && tsc --noEmit && wxt build -b firefox --mode preview
scripts.zip: npm run generate:changelog-json && wxt zip --mode store
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run generate:changelog-json && wxt zip -b firefox --mode store
scripts.zip:preview: npm run generate:changelog-json && wxt zip --mode preview
scripts.zip:preview:firefox: npm run generate:changelog-json && wxt zip -b firefox --mode preview
